relations.subject: Carl Hjalmar Borgstrøm

relations.subject: Carl Hjalmar Borgstrøm
relations.evidence: In 1936-37 Professor of Indian Philology at Ankara in Turkey.

relations.subject: Carl Hjalmar Borgstrøm
relations.evidence: Then Research Scholar at Oslo University working on Gaelic dialects.

relations.subject: Carl Hjalmar Borgstrøm
relations.evidence: became Lecturer in Linguistics at Lund in 1945.

relations.subject: Carl Hjalmar Borgstrøm
relations.evidence: From 1947 Professor of Comparative Linguistics at Oslo. Retired in 1976.
